value.rationale: The motivating full first-Hermite frame-set theorem gives a yes/no classification, while stability depends on optimal spectral bounds. The result finds an exactly quantified arithmetic flux contrast (a factor sqrt(2) in the normalized asymptotic defect), using a genuine noncommutative norm transition. This is a natural and precise quantitative enhancement of recent Hermite Gabor frame studies, not a routine restatement of a sufficiency test or a finite numerical experiment.
